generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of rainy-day commute (雨天出行). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Capture a genuine rainy residential street from a sheltered doorway at pedestrian eye level. One commuter in a hooded rain jacket carries the transparent umbrella and wears clearly visible rubber boots; a second distant cyclist wears one poncho without dominating the frame. Show the backpack cover on the commuter, a covered parked bicycle at one side, the rain gutter above and a drain grate beside a broad pavement puddle below. Freeze one natural rainwater splash near a boot. Cool overcast daylight, visible rain streaks and wet reflections, but retain crisp target edges and avoid a dense crowd.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: hooded rain jacket, transparent umbrella, rubber boots, pavement puddle, street drain grate, rain gutter, waterproof backpack cover, cycling poncho, bicycle rain cover, rainwater splash.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
